description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git submodule branching behavior. It contains various test definitions and setup procedures to verify correct handling of submodule branches, remote tracking, and configuration options.

methods.name: reset_test
methods.description: Resets the test environment by removing specific directories and copying test setup files.

methods.name: test_no_branch
methods.description: Verifies that a specific branch does not exist in a given directory.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success; executes a series of commands and checks for expected output.

methods.name: reset_remote_test
methods.description: Resets the environment for remote repository tests.
